academics.title: Academic setup
academics.description: Your school's years, classes, subjects and who teaches what.

imports.title: Import & export
imports.description: Bring your school's lists into EduCore from a spreadsheet, or download them.

kindDescriptions.STUDENTS: One row per student, with their class and (optionally) one parent or guardian. Re-importing the same admission number updates the student.
kindDescriptions.STAFF: Teachers, admins and accountants. The role column says which (teacher, admin or accountant). Matched on email.
kindDescriptions.CLASSES: One row per class and section for the chosen year, e.g. JSS 1 / A. Import these before students.

imports.fileHint: Save your spreadsheet as CSV (UTF-8). Max 2 MB / 5,000 rows. Dates as DD/MM/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD.
imports.exportDescription: Download current lists. The columns match the import templates, so you can edit and re-import.

report.fatalHint: Fix the problem below, save as CSV and upload it again.
report.readyHint: Rows with problems will be skipped. You can fix them and import a corrected file afterwards — rows already imported are updated, not duplicated.
report.start: Import {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
report.startTitle: Import {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}?
report.startDescription: This adds or updates records in your school. Each change is recorded in the audit log.
report.cancelDescription: Rows already imported stay; the rest won't be imported.
report.failedHint: Rows imported before it stopped were saved. Upload the file again to finish — existing rows will be updated, not duplicated.
